templates.titlePattern: {count} Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
templates.editorialBrief: Use real streets, blocks, corridors, or micro-districts within the practical orbit of this specific campus. Give exactly one sourced reason for each and do not substitute broad city neighborhoods, isolated businesses, safety claims, or demographic stereotypes.
templates.exactTitle: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each

templates.titlePattern: Your First Weekend at {school}, Shared as Cards
templates.editorialBrief: Build a plausible under-21-safe first-weekend sequence, not a ranking. Give each card one role in the sequence and use evergreen places or recurring behaviors rather than one-time events. Be conservative about hours, access, and travel time unless directly sourced.
templates.exactTitle: Your First Weekend at Florida Gulf Coast University, Shared as Cards
